item.title: Melbourne Fuel Prices by Suburb 2026: Where to Save on Petrol Right Now
item.description:
Melbourne’s fuel prices have gone through the roof. With the Iran conflict disrupting global oil supply, average petrol prices across Melbourne hit $2.18 per litre this week — up 23 cents from February 2026. Some suburbs are paying significantly more than others.

Here’s the breakdown and how to stop getting ripped off.

Melbourne Fuel Prices by Suburb — March 2026

Suburb Avg Price/L vs Melbourne Avg Verdict
Footscray $2.04 -14c CHEAPEST — consistently undercuts
Coburg $2.06 -12c Inner north value
Preston $2.07 -11c Northern corridor savings
Sunshine $2.08 -10c Western savings belt
Brunswick $2.11 -7c Slightly cheaper than inner east
Richmond $2.14 -4c Average range
Fitzroy $2.16 -2c Below average, limited stations
St Kilda $2.19 +1c Beachside premium
South Yarra $2.24 +6c Inner south premium
Brighton $2.26 +8c Bayside tax
Toorak $2.29 +11c MOST EXPENSIVE — premium postcode, premium pump

Melbourne Average (March 2026): $2.18/L (unleaded 91)
